item.title: ‘Artificial’ Trailer: Andrew Garfield Stars As OpenAI CEO Sam Altman In Luca Guadagnino’s Silicon Valley Drama
item.description: How do you get fired from the company you helped build, only to return five days later with more power than ever? That’s the extraordinary corporate drama at the center of Luca Guadagnino ’s “ Artificial ,” a darkly comic account of the 2023 OpenAI boardroom coup that briefly ousted CEO Sam Altman before an employee revolt and investor pressure helped engineer his return. Andrew Garfield plays Altman in the film, which NEON is bringing to theaters this Christmas, and a new trailer offers a look at one of Silicon Valley’s strangest power struggles. Continue reading ‘Artificial’ Trailer: Andrew Garfield Stars As OpenAI CEO Sam Altman In Luca Guadagnino’s Silicon Valley Drama at The Playlist.

item.title: 'Burial Hill': Vin Diesel's Next Feature Film Is An Amazon MGM Studios Action Pic From 'The Rip' Writer & 'Luther' Director
item.description: For the longest time, Vin Diesel has been pretty much churning out installments of " The Fast & The Furious " franchise with " Forever Fast ," the 11th film, on deck, but he's looking toward the future and has secured a lead part in an original action film at Amazon MGM Studios (becoming one of the more notable places for the action genre) called " Burial Hill ." As pointed out by the report from Deadline, the possible franchise-starter has a script penned by Mike McGrale ("The Following," "CSI: Miami"), who previously wrote films such as Ben Affleck / Matt Damon 's dirty cop thriller " The Rip " and Donnie Yen 's " John Wick " spinoff " Caine ." They've also enlisted director Jamie Payne , the helmer of Netflix ’s " Luther " movies starring Idris Elba and the original series. Continue reading 'Burial Hill': Vin Diesel's Next Feature Film Is An Amazon MGM Studios Action Pic From 'The Rip' Writer & 'Luther' Director at The Playlist.

item.title: A24 Is Going For Best Picture History As 'Cliff Booth' Unfurls [Contender Countdown]
item.description: Historical trends for the Academy Awards are meant to be broken. From embarrassingly long waits for major wins for women, African Americans, Asian, Latino, and openly LGBTQ+ nominees to international films taking Best Picture, change does happen. But, as in life, and for better or worse, it's often incremental. "Parasite" was the first non-English language film to win Best Picture, but many incredible nominees came before it. Now, A24 is attempting to make history by not only shepherding "You Can See Everything" as the first documentary to earn a Best Picture nomination, but also the first documentary to win. Continue reading A24 Is Going For Best Picture History As 'Cliff Booth' Unfurls [Contender Countdown] at The Playlist.
